capabilities: convert selected text between old and new Japanese orthography
convert kana usage only, with or without small kana preserved
convert kanji forms only, old or new
run conversions from the ribbon, command palette, text menu, or mobile toolbar
extras: The bundled dictionary was rebuilt from earlier kkh work, so vocabulary (and thus conversion accuracy) is reduced, but results now match the Emacs, Vim, and VSCode versions. Variant-character (IVS) vocabulary is excluded to avoid tofu glyphs in fonts without IVS support; smartphone use is not recommended by the author.
intentEvidence: kkh を Obsidian に移植したプラグインです
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert text between kyūjitai/kyūkanazukai and shinjitai/shinkanazukai, which writers of classical-style Japanese need.
